<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"/><meta name="color-scheme" content="only light"/><title>StarNews × RampRate | Building What Endures</title><style>
:root{color-scheme:only light;--bg:#f8f7f2;--ink:#222820;--sub:#5c6158;--accent:#b25b3d;--pale:#e9e5da;--tint:#ede9df;--rule:#d8d6cc;--dark:#17221e;--terra:#d99472;--serif:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;--sans:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;--mono:Consolas,'Courier New',monospace}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;line-height:1.5}
img{max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}
h1,h2,h3,.statement,.intro,.lead,.cell,.tag,.areas span,.r,.micro,.metric span,.mrow .c.goal,summary h3{text-wrap:balance}
.nw{white-space:nowrap}
br.dsk{display:inline}
p,li,td{text-wrap:pretty}
header{max-width:1480px;margin:auto;padding:29px clamp(24px,5vw,90px)}
.brand{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em}.brand span{color:var(--accent)}
.wrap{max-width:1480px;margin:auto;padding-inline:clamp(24px,7vw,118px)}
.eyebrow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.19em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);margin:0 0 22px;line-height:1.55}
.tag{font:12px/1.5 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--accent);margin:0 0 10px;text-transform:uppercase}
.micro{font:11px/1.55 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--sub);margin:0}
.small{font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--sub)}
.copy{max-width:760px;font-size:17px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--sub);margin:0 0 18px}
.intro{font:normal clamp(19px,2.2vw,28px)/1.42 var(--serif);max-width:820px;margin:0 0 26px}
.lead{font:normal clamp(20px,2vw,27px)/1.5 var(--serif);max-width:600px;margin:0 0 22px}
.rule{height:1px;background:var(--pale)}
.slide{padding-block:clamp(60px,7.5vw,108px)}
.tint{background:var(--tint)}
.slide h2{font:normal clamp(36px,4.8vw,72px)/1.08 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:0 0 28px;max-width:1000px}
.slide h2 em,.hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent)}
.bul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.bul li{position:relative;padding-left:22px;margin:0 0 12px;line-height:1.55;font-size:16px}
.bul li:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:.72em;width:9px;height:2px;background:var(--accent)}
.bul li strong{font-weight:700}
.bul.big li{font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,20px);margin-bottom:16px}
/* hero */
.hero{min-height:84vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;align-items:center;gap:clamp(30px,5vw,90px);padding-block:7vh 10vh}
.hero h1{font:normal clamp(52px,7vw,108px)/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:0 0 30px}
.art{margin:0;display:block;overflow:hidden;border-radius:48% 48% 3px 3px/22% 22% 3px 3px;position:relative;isolation:isolate;background:#e4d9c9}
.art img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:520px;object-fit:cover;object-position:53% center;filter:saturate(.8)}
/* contrast panel (slide 01) */
.top2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(30px,6vw,110px);align-items:start}
.panel{margin-top:clamp(50px,6vw,84px);padding-top:30px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.panel-h{font:normal clamp(24px,2.8vw,38px)/1.2 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 30px;max-width:860px}
.panel-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1fr;gap:clamp(20px,3vw,44px);align-items:center}
.coin{margin:0}.coin img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.versus{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}
.vbox{padding:24px 26px 28px;background:var(--tint);border-top:2px solid var(--ink)}
.vbox.became{border-top-color:var(--accent);background:#fff}
.vbox h3{font:normal 26px/1.15 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:0 0 18px}
.wms{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 14px;margin:0 0 18px;padding:0;list-style:none}
.wms li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid #c9c6ba;background:#fff;font:14px/1 var(--sans)}
.wms img{display:block;height:30px;width:auto;max-width:130px}
.vbox.stayed .wms li{font-weight:400;border-color:#a9aa9f;color:var(--sub)}
.vbox p{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--sub)}
.fork{margin:26px 0 0;font:normal clamp(20px,2vw,26px)/1.35 var(--serif)}
/* duo boxes (slides 02, 03) */
.duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 60px 1fr;align-items:stretch;margin-top:8px}
.duo .arrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:44px/1 var(--serif);color:var(--accent)}
.box{padding:26px 28px 30px;background:var(--bg);border-top:2px solid var(--ink)}
.tint .box{background:var(--bg)}
.box.future{border-top-color:var(--accent);background:#fff}
.box h3{font:normal clamp(26px,2.6vw,34px)/1.12 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 20px}
.box .cap{margin:18px 0 0;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);font:15px/1.5 var(--serif);color:var(--sub)}
.metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:clamp(20px,3vw,50px);margin:38px 0 46px;padding:26px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.metric b{display:block;font:normal clamp(34px,4vw,56px)/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:-.07em}
.metric span{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--sub);max-width:250px;margin-top:10px}
.statement{font:normal clamp(28px,4vw,58px)/1.16 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:1080px;margin:0}
.statement em{color:var(--accent)}
/* dark turning point */
.dark{background:var(--dark);color:#f3efe5}
.dark .eyebrow{color:var(--terra)}
.dark h2 em{color:var(--terra)}
.dark .tag{color:var(--terra)}
.dark .box{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-top-color:#53645b}
.dark .box.future{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-top-color:var(--terra)}
.dark .duo .arrow{color:var(--terra)}
.rows{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.rows li{padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid #43534b;font:normal clamp(21px,2.1vw,28px)/1.2 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.rows li:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid #43534b}
.rows.n li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;align-items:baseline}
.rows.n li i{font:normal clamp(28px,3vw,40px)/1 var(--mono);color:var(--terra);letter-spacing:-.06em;font-style:normal;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
/* scope (04) */
.tl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 3fr;gap:6px;margin:6px 0 40px}
.tl .bar{height:10px;background:var(--accent)}
.tl .seg+.seg .bar{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#b9b4a6 0 8px,transparent 8px 14px)}
.tl .t{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--sub)}
.tl .t b{display:block;font:700 11px/1.5 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px}
.mrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px minmax(190px,.9fr) 1.15fr 1.15fr;gap:clamp(16px,2.2vw,32px);padding:26px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(34,40,32,.3);align-items:start}
.mhead{border-top:0;padding:0 0 12px}
.mhead span{font:700 10px/1.5 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--sub);text-transform:uppercase}
.mrow .n{font:12px var(--mono);color:var(--accent);padding-top:7px}
.mrow h3{font:normal clamp(24px,2.4vw,33px)/1.14 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.028em;margin:0}
.mrow .c{font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.mrow .c .bul li{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:8px}
.mrow .c.goal{padding-left:18px;border-left:2px solid var(--accent)}
.mrow.engine{background:rgba(178,91,61,.07);padding-inline:18px;margin-inline:-18px;border-top:2px solid var(--accent)}
.mrow.engine .n{font-size:11px}
.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;align-items:baseline;padding-top:26px;border-top:1px solid rgba(34,40,32,.3);margin-top:0}
.foot p{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;max-width:760px}
/* image slots */
.img-slot{margin:0 0 clamp(34px,4vw,56px);aspect-ratio:1700/728;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e7dccb,#d7bfa3 55%,#c29a7a)}
.img-slot img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.img-slot .fill{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:20px;font:11px/1.6 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#6a4a38;text-transform:uppercase}
/* ai (05) */
.pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(30px,5vw,84px)}
.pair h3{font:normal clamp(24px,2.5vw,32px)/1.15 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.028em;margin:0 0 22px}
.pair>div{border-top:2px solid var(--ink);padding-top:22px}
.pair>div.alt{border-top-color:var(--accent)}
.areas{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.areas li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:132px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:15px;line-height:1.5}
.areas li:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.areas b{font:700 11px/1.7 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}
.how{margin-top:clamp(36px,4vw,56px);padding:22px 26px;background:var(--tint);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:12px 28px;align-items:baseline}
.how .micro{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700}
.how p{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
/* advisory (06) */
.hint{font:12px/1.5 var(--mono);color:var(--sub);letter-spacing:.04em;margin:0 0 14px}
.domains{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:clamp(28px,6vw,100px);align-items:start;margin-bottom:46px}
details.domain{border-top:1px solid #c9c6ba}
details.domain summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:22px 54px 22px 0;position:relative}
details.domain summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
details.domain summary:after{content:'+';position:absolute;right:4px;top:18px;font:300 36px/1 var(--serif);color:var(--accent)}
details.domain[open] summary:after{content:'\2013'}
details.domain .idx{font:12px/1.5 var(--mono);color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
details.domain h3{font:normal clamp(23px,2.3vw,31px)/1.15 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.028em;margin:0}
details.domain .body{padding:2px 0 26px}
details.domain .body .bul li{font-size:15px}
.calib{max-width:900px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:26px}
.calib h3{font:normal clamp(22px,2.2vw,28px)/1.2 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:0 0 16px}
/* commercial (07) */
.farm.one{grid-template-columns:1fr}.farm.one>div{max-width:860px}
.farm{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:clamp(30px,6vw,100px);align-items:start;margin-bottom:clamp(36px,4vw,56px)}
.farm h3{font:normal clamp(26px,3vw,40px)/1.15 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 20px}
.proof{display:grid;gap:26px}
.proof .metric{padding-left:20px;border-left:2px solid var(--accent)}
.proof .metric b{font-size:clamp(34px,3.6vw,50px)}
.src{font:11px/1.6 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--sub);margin-top:6px}
.src a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.today{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(24px,5vw,80px);padding:24px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);margin-bottom:34px}
.today .metric b{font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,54px)}
/* role (08) */
.role{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,2fr);gap:clamp(34px,5vw,80px);margin-top:10px}
.role .col{border-top:2px solid var(--ink);padding-top:22px}
.role .col.rr{border-top-color:var(--accent)}
.person{margin:0 0 26px}
.person img,.mem img{display:block;width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;margin:0 0 12px;background:#d9d4c6}
.person h4,.mem h4{font:normal 22px/1.2 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 4px}
.person .r,.mem .r{font:11px/1.5 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--accent);text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 8px}
.person p.d{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--sub)}
.mem .r{white-space:nowrap}
.mems{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:clamp(14px,2vw,28px);margin-bottom:30px}
.mem img{width:104px;height:104px}
.together{border-top:1px solid #c9c6ba;padding-top:22px}
.together h3{font:normal 24px/1.2 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 16px}
.two{columns:2;column-gap:36px}
.two li{break-inside:avoid}
.partners{margin-top:30px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid #c9c6ba}
.logos{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:20px clamp(22px,3vw,46px);margin:12px 0 14px}
.logos img{display:block;height:54px;width:auto;max-width:190px;object-fit:contain}
.logos img.sm{height:46px}
/* 90 days (09) */
.lanes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));column-gap:20px;row-gap:12px;margin-top:34px}
.lh{font:700 11px/1.5 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink)}
.lh i{display:block;font:normal 16px/1.3 var(--serif);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--sub);margin-top:4px}
.lane{display:contents;--lc:var(--accent)}
.lane.l2{--lc:#222820}.lane.l3{--lc:#6f7f55}.lane.l4{--lc:#a47a3b}.lane.l5{--lc:#6b7066}.lane.out{--lc:#222820}
.ll{font:700 12px/1.4 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lc);padding-top:20px}
.cell{position:relative;padding:22px 6px 18px 0;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5}
.cell:before{content:'';position:absolute;top:7px;left:0;right:-20px;height:2px;background:var(--lc)}
.cell:last-child:before{right:0}
.cell:after{content:'';position:absolute;top:1px;left:0;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lc)}
.cell .m{display:none}
.lane.out .cell:after{border-radius:0;transform:rotate(45deg);width:12px;height:12px;top:2px}
.lane.out .cell{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--sub)}
.lane.out .cell strong{display:block;font:700 10px/1.5 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px}
.gate{margin-top:22px;padding:18px 22px;background:var(--ink);color:#f3efe5;display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap}
.gate b{font:700 11px/1.5 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--terra);text-transform:uppercase}
.gate span{font:normal 19px/1.35 var(--serif)}
/* structure (10, 11) */
.strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin:26px 0 40px;padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(70,60,50,.25);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(70,60,50,.25)}
.strip p{margin:0;line-height:1.5;font-size:15px}
.strip .micro{margin:0 0 8px}
.strip .on .micro{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.tiers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(30px,6vw,90px);margin:0 0 30px}
.tier{border-top:2px solid var(--ink);padding-top:24px}
.tier.b{border-top-color:var(--accent)}
.tier h3{font:normal clamp(26px,2.8vw,36px)/1.12 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 10px}
.tier .sub{font-size:15px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--sub);margin:0 0 20px;min-height:3.1em}
.price{font:normal clamp(42px,5vw,70px)/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:-.07em}
.price .per{font:normal clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px)/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-left:10px;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.tier .total{margin:10px 0 22px;font:12px/1.5 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--sub)}
.tier .bul li{font-size:15px}
.note{margin:6px 0 0;padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(70,60,50,.25);line-height:1.65}
.eqhead{padding-top:clamp(50px,6vw,84px);border-top:1px solid rgba(70,60,50,.25);margin-top:clamp(50px,6vw,84px)}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);margin:28px 0 34px}
.stats .price{font-size:clamp(40px,4.6vw,64px)}
.stats .micro{margin-top:10px}
.stats .small{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.55}
.eq2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.2vw,60px)!important}
.guarantee{margin:0 0 40px;padding:28px 0;border-top:2px solid var(--accent);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(70,60,50,.25);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px;align-items:start}
.guarantee>div{max-width:780px}
.guarantee h3{font:normal clamp(28px,5vw,72px)/1.02 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:0}
.guarantee p{margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--sub)}
.guarantee p+p{margin-top:10px;font-size:13px}
.pool{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;text-align:left;margin-top:12px}
.pool th{padding:14px 14px 14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;font:700 11px/1.4 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.pool th:last-child,.pool td:last-child{text-align:right;padding-right:0;white-space:nowrap}
.pool td{padding:16px 14px 16px 0;vertical-align:top;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(100,90,75,.2);font-size:15px;line-height:1.55}
.pool td:first-child{width:27%;font-weight:700}
.pool td:last-child{font:600 16px/1.4 var(--mono);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;width:17%}
.pool td:last-child small{display:block;font:11px/1.5 var(--sans);color:var(--sub);white-space:normal;margin-top:4px}
.pool tr.multi td:last-child{color:var(--accent)}
.terms{max-width:900px;margin:30px 0 0}
.terms p{margin:0 0 14px}
/* advisor economics (12) */
.econ{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(24px,3.5vw,52px);margin:34px 0 48px}
.econ>div{border-top:2px solid var(--ink);padding-top:20px}
.econ>div.earn{border-top-color:var(--accent)}
.econ h3{font:normal clamp(23px,2.3vw,30px)/1.15 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.028em;margin:0 0 16px}
.econ .earn .tag:after{content:' · where most of the equity vests';text-transform:none}
.nums{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(24px,5vw,80px);padding-top:26px;border-top:1px solid rgba(70,60,50,.25)}
.nums .price{font-size:clamp(38px,4.4vw,62px)}
.nums .micro{margin-top:10px}
/* team (13) */
.team{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(22px,3vw,44px);margin:30px 0 30px}
.team article{border-top:2px solid var(--ink);padding-top:22px}
.team img{display:block;width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;margin:0 0 16px;background:#d9d4c6}
.team h3{font:normal 27px/1.15 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 6px}
.team p{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--sub)}
.team p.tag{color:var(--accent)}
.team .tag{margin-bottom:8px}
.foot2{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--sub);max-width:900px;margin:0 0 46px}
.expand{max-width:900px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:26px}
.expand h3{font:normal clamp(24px,3vw,36px)/1.18 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0 0 18px}
/* closing */
.closing{padding:clamp(80px,11vw,170px) 0;background:#eae5da}
.closing h2{font:normal clamp(38px,5.4vw,84px)/1.06 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.05em;max-width:1080px;margin:0 0 34px}
.closing h2 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent)}
.closing p:not(.eyebrow){font:normal clamp(19px,2.1vw,28px)/1.45 var(--serif);max-width:820px;margin:0}
.footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding-block:30px;font-size:12px;color:var(--sub)}
/* responsive */
@media(max-width:1180px){.team{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.mems{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);row-gap:24px}}
@media(max-width:1000px){.lanes{grid-template-columns:120px repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));column-gap:14px}.cell{font-size:14px}.cell:before{right:-14px}}

@media(max-width:860px){

/* Editorial culture comparison: inherits the proposal's type, color and spacing system. */
/* Foundation: cinematic editorial comparison, responsive, native proposal typography */
.culture-panel{--culture-rule:var(--rule)}
.culture-panel>.eyebrow{margin-bottom:18px}
.culture-panel .panel-h{max-width:880px;margin-bottom:28px}
.culture-branches{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,.86fr) minmax(0,1.14fr);gap:clamp(25px,4vw,60px);align-items:stretch;border-top:1px solid var(--culture-rule);padding-top:30px}
.culture-photograph{margin:0;min-height:330px;overflow:hidden;background:#796959}
.culture-photograph img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:38% 50%;display:block}
.culture-choices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,2vw,34px);align-content:center}
.culture-choice{padding:10px 0;min-width:0}
.culture-choice+.culture-choice{border-left:1px solid var(--culture-rule);padding-left:clamp(16px,2vw,32px)}
.culture-kicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;margin:0 0 15px}
.culture-choice h4{font:normal clamp(23px,2.3vw,33px)/1.12 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0 0 18px}
.culture-names{font:normal clamp(15px,1.3vw,18px)/1.45 var(--serif);margin:0 0 17px}
.culture-names span{color:var(--accent);padding:0 .1em}
.culture-choice>p:last-child{font-size:clamp(13px,1.1vw,15px);line-height:1.6;max-width:410px;margin:0}
.culture-panel .fork{border-top:1px solid var(--culture-rule);padding-top:22px;margin-top:26px}
@media(max-width:900px){.culture-branches{grid-template-columns:1fr}.culture-photograph{height:300px;min-height:0}.culture-choices{gap:30px}}
@media(max-width:540px){.culture-photograph{height:240px}.culture-choices{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}.culture-choice+.culture-choice{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--culture-rule);padding:22px 0 8px}}

/* Approved Section 01 composition: native artwork, no diagram reconstruction. */
.foundation-composition{padding:0!important;max-width:none!important;width:100%;margin:0 auto!important;overflow:hidden;background:#f4f0e9}
.foundation-art{margin:0 auto;width:100%;max-width:1536px;line-height:0}
.foundation-art img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1536 / 946;object-fit:contain}
.foundation-context{padding-top:clamp(40px,5vw,78px);padding-bottom:clamp(45px,5vw,78px);border-top:1px solid rgba(80,65,50,.15)}
.foundation-context h2{max-width:800px;margin:0 0 12px}
.foundation-context .intro{margin-bottom:22px}
/* A single editorial reading column: the argument is read top to bottom. */
.foundation-points{list-style:none;margin:28px 0 0;padding:0;max-width:810px;counter-reset:foundation}
.foundation-points li{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:84px minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:start;padding:22px 0 24px;border-top:1px solid rgba(80,65,50,.20);font-size:clamp(17px,1.65vw,22px);line-height:1.43;letter-spacing:-.012em;color:var(--ink)}
.foundation-points li::before{counter-increment:foundation;content:counter(foundation, decimal-leading-zero);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(25px,2.7vw,37px);line-height:1;color:#a85632;font-weight:400}
.foundation-points li:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(80,65,50,.20)}
@media(max-width:640px){.foundation-context{padding-left:22px;padding-right:22px}.foundation-points{margin-top:20px}.foundation-points li{grid-template-columns:48px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;padding:18px 0 20px;font-size:17px}.foundation-points li::before{font-size:24px}}

/* Section 05: integrated editorial split hero */
#ai .ai-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52% 48%;align-items:center;min-height:clamp(430px,43vw,620px);position:relative;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:clamp(35px,5vw,75px)}

/* Section 05: editorial split hero followed by full-width content */
#ai .ai-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,49%) minmax(0,51%);align-items:center;position:relative;min-height:clamp(390px,38vw,550px);margin-bottom:clamp(32px,4vw,62px);overflow:visible}

#ai > .wrap:not(.ai-hero){width:100%;}
@media(max-width:750px){#ai .ai-hero{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;gap:0}#ai .ai-hero-copy{width:100%;padding:25px 0 0}#ai .ai-hero-visual{width:100%;height:300px;margin-top:-10px;background-position:center,center;mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 78% 74% at 50% 50%,black 54%,transparent 100%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 78% 74% at 50% 50%,black 54%,transparent 100%)}}
#ai .ai-hero-visual{overflow:hidden;background:none!important;isolation:isolate;mask-image:none!important;-webkit-mask-image:none!important}
#ai .ai-hero-visual img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 73% 76% at 50% 49%,#000 30%,rgba(0,0,0,.95) 47%,rgba(0,0,0,.48) 70%,transparent 100%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 73% 76% at 50% 49%,#000 30%,rgba(0,0,0,.95) 47%,rgba(0,0,0,.48) 70%,transparent 100%)}
/* Feather all four edges into the actual page colour, rather than displaying a rectangular image. */
#ai .ai-hero-visual{background:var(--bg)!important;overflow:visible;isolation:auto}
@media(max-width:750px){#ai .ai-hero-visual img{mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 77% 74% at 50% 50%,#000 32%,rgba(0,0,0,.8) 56%,transparent 100%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 77% 74% at 50% 50%,#000 32%,rgba(0,0,0,.8) 56%,transparent 100%)}}

/* Section 05: artwork is colour-matched to --bg and fades through actual transparency. */
#ai .ai-hero-visual{background:transparent!important;overflow:visible!important;mask:none!important;-webkit-mask:none!important}
#ai .ai-hero-visual img{mask:none!important;-webkit-mask:none!important;mix-blend-mode:normal;object-fit:contain!important}
.img-slot-07{background:transparent;overflow:visible}
.img-slot-07 img{object-fit:contain}

/* Section 07: align the original editorial typography and right-side artwork. */
#commercial .commercial-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,43%) minmax(0,57%);align-items:center;gap:0;min-height:clamp(360px,35vw,510px);margin-bottom:clamp(28px,4vw,54px)}
#commercial .commercial-hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:1;padding:28px 0}
#commercial .commercial-hero-copy h2{font:normal clamp(36px,4.8vw,72px)/1.08 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:0 0 28px;max-width:620px}
#commercial .commercial-hero-copy .intro{font:normal clamp(19px,2.2vw,28px)/1.42 var(--serif);max-width:510px;margin:0}
#commercial .commercial-hero-art{min-width:0;position:relative;margin-left:-15%;margin-right:-8%;align-self:stretch;display:flex;align-items:center}

@media(max-width:750px){#commercial .commercial-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0;gap:0}#commercial .commercial-hero-copy{padding:18px 0 0}#commercial .commercial-hero-art{margin:0 -4%;max-height:350px}#commercial .img-slot-07 img{max-height:350px;object-fit:contain}#commercial .commercial-hero-copy h2{font-size:clamp(33px,9.4vw,44px)}}
/* Section 07: contain the illustration and connect the concept directly to the hero. */
@media(min-width:751px){
 #commercial .commercial-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,48%) minmax(0,52%);min-height:0;gap:18px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px}

}

/* Section 07: consistent editorial hierarchy for the data-farming proposition */
#commercial .farm-editorial{margin-top:clamp(16px,2.5vw,32px);margin-bottom:clamp(30px,4vw,52px)}
#commercial .farm-editorial>div{max-width:900px}
#commercial .farm-editorial .tag{margin:0 0 13px}
#commercial .farm-editorial h3{font:normal clamp(29px,3.2vw,43px)/1.14 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.035em;max-width:820px;margin:0 0 28px}
#commercial .farm-mechanics{max-width:820px}
#commercial .farm-mechanics .farm-subhead{font:600 14px/1.4 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);margin:0;padding:0 0 12px;border:0}
#commercial .farm-mechanics p:not(.farm-subhead){font:normal clamp(16px,1.45vw,19px)/1.6 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);margin:0;padding:15px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
#commercial .farm-mechanics p.farm-evidence{font-size:clamp(14px,1.2vw,16px);color:var(--sub)}

/* Final typography consistency pass: section-level hierarchy */
.slide > .wrap > .eyebrow, .slide.wrap > .eyebrow,
#ai .ai-hero-copy > .eyebrow, #commercial .commercial-hero-copy > .eyebrow {
  font-size:11px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.55; letter-spacing:.19em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
/* Editorial proposition: distinct from section headline, aligned with other subheads */
#commercial .farm-editorial h3 {
  font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,40px);
  line-height:1.15;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;
}
/* Consistent body scale for the paired operational explanations */
#commercial .farm-mechanics p:not(.farm-evidence) {
  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.6;
}
#commercial .farm-mechanics p.farm-evidence {
  font-size:14.5px;
  line-height:1.6;
}

/* Section 07: concise validation note following Bluenumber evidence */
#commercial .farm-validation{margin-top:1.25rem;padding-top:1.1rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(58,65,63,.18)}
#commercial .farm-validation .farm-subhead{margin:0 0 .55rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.11em;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:650}
#commercial .farm-validation p:last-child{margin:0;max-width:65ch;font-size:inherit;line-height:1.65}

/* Section 01: headline on left, four numbered statements on right. */
#foundation .foundation-two-column{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.86fr) minmax(0,1.14fr);column-gap:clamp(44px,6vw,100px);align-items:start;margin-top:clamp(24px,3vw,48px)}
#foundation .foundation-headline-column h2{max-width:100%;margin:0 0 18px}
#foundation .foundation-headline-column .intro{margin:0;max-width:390px}
#foundation .foundation-two-column .foundation-points{max-width:none;margin:0;min-width:0}
#foundation .foundation-two-column .foundation-points li{grid-template-columns:56px minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;padding:17px 0 19px;font-size:clamp(17px,1.4vw,20px)}
#foundation .foundation-two-column .foundation-points li::before{font-size:clamp(25px,2.3vw,33px)}
@media(max-width:760px){#foundation .foundation-two-column{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px;margin-top:20px}#foundation .foundation-two-column .foundation-points li{grid-template-columns:48px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;padding:18px 0 20px;font-size:17px}}

/* Section 07: editorial two-column proposition, preserving all wording. */
@media (min-width: 751px) {
  #commercial .farm.one.farm-editorial {
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:minmax(0, .86fr) minmax(0, 1.14fr);

  }

}

  #commercial .farm-editorial .farm-concept h3 {margin-bottom:0}
}

/* Final typographic line-break audit: retain copy and eliminate isolated last words. */
.widow-delivery{font-size:.94em;letter-spacing:-.012em}
@media(max-width:600px){.widow-delivery{font-size:.91em;letter-spacing:-.018em}.widow-advisor{font-size:.94em;letter-spacing:-.012em}}

/* Closing: complete the opening's roots-to-ownership narrative. */
.closing .closing-narrative{max-width:760px;margin:clamp(30px,4vw,56px) auto 0;text-align:left;}
.closing .closing-narrative p{font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,21px);line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 16px;max-width:710px;text-wrap:pretty;}

@media(max-width:600px){.closing .closing-narrative{margin-top:28px;text-align:left}.closing .closing-narrative p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.5}.closing .closing-narrative .closing-narrative-final{font-size:20px}}

/* Closing composition: align the narrative with the headline's left edge,
   rather than centering a separate narrow block below it. */
.closing .closing-narrative{
  width:100%;max-width:790px;
  margin:clamp(22px,3vw,38px) 0 0;

}

</style></head><body>
<header><div class="brand"><img class="rr-logo" alt="RampRate" src="data:image/png;base64,"/><img class="bcorp-logo" alt="Certified B Corporation" src="data:image/png;base64,"><span class="brand-partner">× STARNEWS</span></div></header>
<main>

<section class="wrap hero">
